lines.text: Don't worry, this lunch won't break the bank.

data.define: To cost so much that you can't afford it.

example.text: Don't worry, this lunch won't break the bank.

misuse.text: Don't say 'break the bank' at a bank.
misuse.why: It only means costing too much.

data.l1_hook: Le déjeuner est-il trop cher ? "break the bank"
data.l1_ex: Ne t'inquiète pas, ce déjeuner ne va pas "break the bank".

native.hook: Que veut dire « break the bank » ?
native.tip: “break the bank” = coûter une fortune. Exemple: “Don't worry, this lunch won't break the bank.”
